content: Nan Korint
Mwurin mepwukat Pohl eri mweselsang Adens oh kolahng Korint.

Wasao e ahpw tuhwong mehn Suhs emen me adaneki Akwila, me ipwidier nan Pondus, me ahpwtehn kohdo sang Itali iangahki eh pwoud Persila, pwehki Sihsar Klaudius eh ketin koasoanehdi me mehn Suhs koaros en pekeussang nan Rom. Pohl eri kohla pwe en tuhwong ira,
oh kousoan rehra, oh iang ira doadoahk, pwehki e pil duwehte ira me kin momourki wiahda ihmw likou kan.
E kin koasoakoasoiong mehn Suhs oh mehn Krihs kan nan sinakoke kan ni rahnen Sapad koaros, oh kin songosong en kawekirailla.
Ni en Sailas oh Timoty ara leledo sang Masedonia, Pohl ahpw mweidohng eh ahnsou koaros ong kalohkiseli mahseno, kadekadehdehiong mehn Suhs akan me Sises iei Mesaia.

Eri, ni arail pelianda oh ndahki lokaia suwed kei, e ahpw sapeng irail ni eh sipedasang pwelen eh likou kan, kilel en eh pahn piseksang irail, oh ndaiong irail, “Ma kumwail pahn salongala, eri, pein kumwail me uhdahn pahn pwukoahki; I sohte pahn pwukoahki! Sang met kohla I pahn kolahng rehn mehn liki kan.”
Pohl eri mweselsang rehrail oh kohla kousoanla nan imwen mehn liki men me adaneki Taitus Sustus, me kin pwongih Koht. Imwen ohl menet mihte limwahn sinakoke en mehn Suhs akan.
Krispus, soumas en sinakokeo, ahpw pwosonla Kaun-o, iangahki eh peneinei koaros. Oh pil me tohtohie nan Korint me rong mahseno, re ahpw pil pwosonla oh papidaisla.
Pwohngpwong Pohl ahpw kilang kaudiahl ehu, oh nan kaudiahl wet Kaun-o ketin mahsanihong, “Pohl, ke dehr masak mehkot, nantihongete omw padapadahk oh dehr peikasal,
pwe I pahn iang uhk. Sohte emen me pahn kak wiahiong uhk mehkot, pwe nei aramas me tohto nan kahnimw wet.”
Pohl eri koukousoanki wasao erein pahr ehu elep, padapadahkihong aramas akan duwen mahsen en Koht.
Eri, ni Kalio eh pilipilda en wia kepinahn Akaia, mehn Suhs akan ahpw pokonpene oh koledi Pohl oh kahrelahng nan imwen kopwung.
Re ahpw nda, “Ohl menet kin songosong en panawiheki aramas akan en kaudok ong Koht ni mwohmw ehu me kin uhwong kosonned!”
Pohl ahpwtehn pahn koasoi, a Kalio mahsanihong mehn Suhs ako, “Ma mehkotet me wiawiher iei sapwung laud ehu, eri, e pahn konehng I en kanengamahiong oh rongorong kumwail mehn Suhs kan.
Ahpw pwehki eh pidada lepin mahsen kan oh ahd akan oh pein amwail kosonned, eri, pein kumwail en koasoanehdi. Pwe I sohte pahn wia sounkopwungpen soahng pwukat!”
E ahpw kausirailieisang nan imwen kopwungo.
Irail eri koledi Sostenihs, soumas en sinakokeo, oh wokih mwohn imwen kopwungo. Eri, Kalio sohte mwahn katapanki mwekid wet.
Pwuralahng Andiok en Siria

Pohl eri mihmihte Korint rehn me pwoson akan rahn tohto, oh e ahpw sereklahng Siria iangahki Persila oh Akwila. Mwohn e pahn sereksang Senkria e ahpw koakoahsang pitenmoange pwehki inou ehu me e wiadahr.
Irail eri lel nan Episos, wasa me Pohl pwilikihdi Persila oh Akwila ie. E ahpw pedolong nan sinakoke en mehn Suhs kan oh koasoakoasoiong irail.
Re ahpw peki en mihmihki rehrail ahnsou reirei, ahpw e sohte pwungki.
Eri, ni eh pahn mwesel e ahpw ndaiong irail, “Ma iei duwen kupwur en Koht, I pahn pwurodohng rehmwail.” E ahpw sereksang Episos.
Ni eh lelehr Sesaria e ahpw douluhllahng Serusalem oh rahnmwahwih tohn mwomwohdiso; eri, e ahpw douluhllahng Andiok.
Eri, mwurin eh mihmihkier wasao ahnsou kis, e ahpw mwesel. Ih eri kotehla sapwen Kalesia oh Prikia, kakehlakala irail koaros me pwoson akan.
Apolos nan Episos oh Korint
Mehn Suhs emen ede Apolos, me ipwidier nan Aleksandria, ahpw kohdo Episos. Ih ohl emen me kadek kapahrek, oh e pil loalokongki Pwuhk Sarawi.
E sukuhlkiher duwen Ahl en Kaun-o; eri, e kin pwerisek koasoia oh padahkiwei pwungen mour en Sises ni peren. Ahpw e wehwehkihte papidais en Sohn.

Apolos ahpw tapihada eimah padapadahk nan sinakoke en mehn Suhs kan. Ni ahnsou me Persila oh Akwila rongada eh padahk kan, ira ahpw kahrelahng nan imwara oh kawehwehiong ni oaritik duwen pwungen Ahl en Koht.

Apolos eri lemehda en kolahng Akaia. Eri, me pwoson kan me mi Episos ahpw sewese ni arail ntinglahng me pwoson kan nan Akaia, koangngoangehkin irail en kasamwo Apolos wasao. Ni ahnsou me e lel wasao e ahpw wiahda sawas laud ehu ong irail ako me pwosonlahr pwehki kalahngan en Koht.
Pwehki eh akamai kehlail, e powehdi mehn Suhs akan nan akupwung sansal akan, kadekadehde sang nan Pwuhk Sarawi me Sises, iei Mesaia.
